result.instructions: Tools for Pobuca Connect, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find the contact with the email maria@example.com and show her organization and phone numbers."; "Which contacts changed in the last 7 days?"; "Add a new contact: Nikos Georgiou, nikos@example.com, mobile +30 690 000 0000, at Acme Ltd.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Pobuca Connect data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run pobuca_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run pobuca_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run pobuca_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. pobuca_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: pobuca_get_me
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: The Pobuca Connect user this API key acts as: id, first name, last name and email. GET /api/v1/Users/Me.

tools.name: pobuca_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people) with names, phones, emails, addresses, organization, team, tags and custom fields. Paged: 50 per call at most; pass next_skip as skip for the next page. Supports OData $filter and $orderby. To find recently changed contacts use $filter like "updatedat ge 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z". GET /api/v1/Contacts.

filter.description: OData $filter expression, e.g. "updatedat ge 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z" or "startswith(lastname,'Pap')". Field names are case-insensitive.

skip.description: Results to skip. Pass the previous reply's next_skip to get the next page.

tools.name: pobuca_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: One contact by id, with all phone numbers, emails, addresses, organization, team, tags and custom fields. GET /api/v1/Contacts/{id}.

tools.name: pobuca_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a new contact in the Pobuca Connect address book. Needs at least a first name, last name or email. Not idempotent: calling it twice creates two contacts, so search with pobuca_list_contacts first. POST /api/v1/Contacts.

birthday.description: Birthday as an ISO date, e.g. 1985-04-23.

allowEmails.description: Consent flag: may this contact be emailed.

allowPhones.description: Consent flag: may this contact be phoned.

allowSms.description: Consent flag: may this contact be sent SMS.

organizationId.description: Id of the organization this contact belongs to (from pobuca_list_organizations).

teamId.description: Id of the team that owns this contact (from pobuca_list_teams).

tags.description: Tags (replaces the existing tags on update).

valueName.description: The value (for a dropdown field: the option text).

valueId.description: Dropdown option id (only for dropdown fields).

tools.name: pobuca_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing contact; only the fields you pass are sent. Overwrites the previous values (tags and customFields are replaced as given). Look the contact up first and confirm the right one. PATCH /api/v1/Contacts/{id}.
